steps.when: Non-EU visitors on a short stay (up to 90 days in 180) give fingerprints and a photo at their first Schengen border crossing. EU, Icelandic, Liechtenstein, Norwegian and Swiss nationals are not registered; residence permits and long-stay visas can change the process
steps.cost: Free – in full operation since 10 April 2026. Check the official guidance for your nationality and documents, and allow extra time at the border.

_SCHENGEN.facts: Schengen short stays are limited to 90 days in any 180-day period across all Schengen countries together.

steps.when: Issued at the airport e-gate or immigration booth – check the days stamped before you leave the airport
steps.cost: Included in your air ticket for air arrivals; by land MXN 983 for stays over 7 days or beyond the border zone (2026)
steps.tip: Paid 'FMM' websites are not the government – the official site is inm.gob.mx.

MX.facts: Officers grant up to 180 days, but often fewer – the number stamped in your passport is what counts.

steps.t: Egypt e-Visa or visa on arrival

steps.t: Egypt e-Visa or visa on arrival
steps.when: Pay at the airport bank counter before passport control, or apply online ahead
steps.cost: US$30 single entry (since 1 March 2026)
steps.tip: Staying only in the South Sinai resorts (Sharm el-Sheikh, Dahab) for up to 15 days? EU, UK and US passports get a free Sinai-only stamp – but then you can't leave Sinai.

CR.facts: Many passports get up to 180 days, but the immigration officer decides and writes the number in your passport. Your passport must be valid for your whole stay.

FJ.facts: Visa-exempt visitors get a free visitor permit stamped on arrival. Bring a return or onward ticket and proof of where you’re staying.

MU.facts: Mauritius plans a paid pre-boarding e-Visa/ETA for everyone from 2027 – nothing to pay before you fly yet.

SC.facts: The visitor permit itself is free and stamped on arrival for your booked stay, up to 90 days.

TR.facts: Many passports – including the US, UK and most EU countries – are visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180 days.

AE.facts: US, UK and most EU passports get free visa-free entry for 90 days in any 180 days; Ireland gets 30 days. No form or fee before you fly.
